water_quality_recommendations.title: Critical TDS Level - High Dissolved Mineral Ingress
water_quality_recommendations.message: Purifier output TDS reached 580.0 ppm, crossing the critical limit (500.0 ppm). Water contains excessive dissolved mineral content. Immediate filtration check is advised.
water_quality_recommendations.reason: Measured TDS (580.0 ppm) exceeded critical limit (500.0 ppm). 24h historical average is 265.5 ppm with a degrading trend.
water_quality_recommendations.action: Inspect RO membrane rejection efficiency and verify inlet flow restrictor valve.
action_steps: Turn off purifier power and test raw feed water TDS to check for municipal supply surges.
Inspect RO reject water discharge line to ensure brine is flowing freely without flow restriction.
Flush RO membrane system for 3 to 5 minutes.
If TDS remains elevated above 500 ppm after flush, service RO membrane cartridge.

water_quality_recommendations.title: Persistent Degrading Water Quality Trend Identified
water_quality_recommendations.message: Historical analytics detected a continuous declining purity trend across the past 24 hours. Most frequent abnormal parameter: pH.
water_quality_recommendations.reason: Overall purity score has trended downwards across historical readings. 0 warning and 49 critical records logged.
water_quality_recommendations.action: Review historical trend charts and inspect raw feed water quality.
action_steps: Review Analytics page charts to identify timestamp of initial purity score decline.
Verify whether raw feed water quality has deteriorated or pre-filtration pressure has dropped.
Plan preventative cartridge servicing before complete threshold breach.

water_quality_recommendations.title: Acidic Water Quality - Remineralizer Inspection Advised
water_quality_recommendations.message: Drinking water pH has dropped to 5.86, below the safe alkaline balance (6.5). Acidic water can impart a tart taste and may indicate depleted remineralization media.
water_quality_recommendations.reason: Measured pH is 5.86 (safe minimum: 6.5). Post-Carbon Alkaline cartridge condition is currently at 100.0%.
water_quality_recommendations.action: Inspect Stage 4 Post-Carbon Alkaline Mineralizer cartridge and calibrate pH electrode.
action_steps: Rinse pH sensor electrode with distilled water to ensure no surface residue is skewing the probe.
Inspect Stage 4 mineralizer cartridge condition (estimated remaining life: 100.0%).
Perform a fresh 60-second purge cycle to test if reservoir stagnation caused acidity accumulation.

water_quality_recommendations.title: Elevated Turbidity - Sediment Pre-Filter Service Recommended
water_quality_recommendations.message: Simulated turbidity index reached 8.5, crossing the warning limit (5.0). Suspended particulates can increase resistance and foul the downstream RO membrane.
water_quality_recommendations.reason: Turbidity reading (8.5) exceeds baseline threshold (5.0). Stage 1 Sediment Pre-Filter estimated condition is at 100.0%.
water_quality_recommendations.action: Flush purifier inlet line and inspect Stage 1 Sediment Pre-Filter bowl.
action_steps: Visually inspect external spun sediment pre-filter bowl for visible silt, rust, or discoloration.
Execute manual flush for 2 minutes to clear inlet pipeline particles.
Prepare replacement PP-5M spun sediment pre-filter cartridge (current condition: 100.0%).

water_quality_recommendations.action: Check for aerated flow, probe bubbles, or municipal source switching.
action_steps: Inspect probe measurement vessel for micro-bubbles or intermittent water flow.
Verify if tap water supply switched between municipal surface and borewell sources.
Monitor live dashboard graph to observe whether readings return to learned baseline.

water_quality_recommendations.title: Periodic Sensor Probe Maintenance & Rinsing Guidance
water_quality_recommendations.message: Water quality monitoring sensors maintain optimal measurement precision when probe electrodes are periodically inspected and rinsed.
water_quality_recommendations.reason: Routine preventative advice: optical turbidity quartz windows and pH glass electrodes benefit from periodic rinsing.
water_quality_recommendations.action: Inspect probe chamber and gently rinse electrodes with clean water.
action_steps: Inspect the optical turbidity sensor chamber for mineral scale or fine sediment coating.
Rinse probe ends with clean drinking water; avoid abrasive cloths on the pH glass bulb.
Ensure sensor probe cable connections to ESP32 are secure.
